Reestablishes the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (EO 12700) until September 30, 1995. EO 12882 (signed 1993-11-23; Federal Register of November 26, 1993, the revocation paragraph is on 58 FR 62494) revokes "Section 2 of Executive Order" No. 12869 together with EO 12700 and EO 12768 ("(c) Executive Orders Nos. 12700, 12768, and Section 2 of Executive Order" No. 12869 are hereby revoked). EO 12882 has no effective-date wording attached to that paragraph, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1993-11-23. This earlier partial ending of Sec. 2 leaves the other clauses to run to 1995-09-30.

Provides that, notwithstanding any other order, the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for the committees in Sec. 1 and Sec. 2 are performed by the department or agency head named after each committee. Its object is the continued committees, so for the Sec. 1 committees it runs until EO 12974 supersedes the order. EO 12974 (signed 1995-09-29; 60 FR 51875, Federal Register of October 3, 1995) supersedes EO 12869 in its Sec. 4 ("Sec. 4. Executive Order No. 12869 is superseded.") and Sec. 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1995, so the end is 1995-09-30. The order's own date (continued until September 30, 1995) gives the same date on the inclusive reading; on the exclusive reading (the continuance stops when that day begins) the date is also 1995-09-30. (The Sec. 2 committee's part ended earlier, on 1993-11-23, with its revocation; the clause as a whole continues for the Sec. 1 committees.)

Lead of the revocation list: revokes the listed orders or sections that established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed. A one-time revocation performed when the order took effect, September 30, 1993 (Sec. 6; the held text spaces the characters of that date because of the scan), so the command is exhausted on 1993-09-30. The revoked orders stay revoked; that surviving consequence is separate from this exhausted command.

conflict_resolutions.WHOLE_END_DATE_MISSING_OR_DISPUTED: The dossier flags a whole-order end date that is missing or disputed because candidate endings differ by clause. Resolution: the clauses end on different dates for stated reasons (Sec. 2 on 1993-11-23 by EO 12882; Sec. 4 to 6 on 1993-09-30 by performance; Sec. 1 and Sec. 3 on 1995-09-30 by EO 12974 Sec. 4 and Sec. 5), and the whole-order end is the latest of them, 1995-09-30.

research_rationale:
EO 12869 of September 30, 1993 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees), read in full in the held Federal Register text (58 FR 51751, Federal Register of October 4, 1993; machine-extracted text layer, spaced characters from the scan). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1993-09-30). Sec. 1 continues ten advisory committees until September 30, 1995; Sec. 2 reestablishes the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology until the same date; Sec. 3 assigns the Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to department heads; Sec. 4 revokes six committee orders or sections; Sec. 5 supersedes EO 12774; Sec. 6 makes the order effective September 30, 1993. Inventory: the dossier's 22 clauses (Sec. 1 with items (a) to (j), Sec. 2, 3, Sec. 4 with items (a) to (f), Sec. 5, 6) cover every operative sentence. Findings: Sec. 2 was ended first, on 1993-11-23, by EO 12882's express revocation of section 2; the continuance clauses (Sec. 1, Sec. 3 for the Sec. 1 committees) end on 1995-09-30 by EO 12974 Sec. 4, effective under its Sec. 5; Sec. 4, 5 and 6 are performed or spent on the effective date 1993-09-30. The whole-order end is therefore the latest clause end, 1995-09-30. Search: besides the dossier's machine searches, I ran a by-number scan of all held order texts for each of the ten Sec. 1 committees' establishing-order numbers (EO 11145, 12196, 11183, 12367, 12216, 11776, 11287, 12345, 12131, 12382); among held texts of orders signed between 1993-09-30 and 1995-09-29 none revokes or terminates one of those committees (the scan's only hit in that window is EO 12907, which amends EO 12882). Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning. Machine hits for this order: current-law:usc 2, current-law:ecfr 2, later-events:ofr_catalog 3. The packet's by-number scan of held order texts (LOOKUPS) was read for this order; held texts citing this number include EO 12882 (partial revocation) and EO 12974 (supersession).
